reuse.why: Group notes already live in the notes table keyed by the group id (read elsewhere in actions.ts and notes/app.ts), but the change adds a new category_groups.notes column via migration instead of joining that table.

duplication.why: The #fixed test is pasted as the same SQL clause into five queries plus a JS includes() in copyPreviousMonth, extending the existing copy-per-action pattern rather than consolidating it.

placement.why: Introduces a schema change and a second storage location for notes, contrary to the tree's notes layer, while the rule itself is spread across each action's SQL.

scope.why: The edits target month-wide actions, but a migration and DbCategoryGroup type change are added that the request does not need given the existing notes store.

maintainability.why: Notes written through the UI go to the notes table, so the new column would stay empty and diverge, and the rule must be kept in sync across six hand-written filters in two languages (SQL LIKE vs JS includes).

bypasses_abstraction.where: migrations/1791849600000_add_category_group_notes.sql and actions.ts queries read g.notes instead of the existing notes table (notes n ON n.id = g.id) used by notes/app.ts and actions.ts setCategoryCarryover.

disguised_duplication.where: The five SQL clauses are verbatim copies; the copyPreviousMonth JS check is the same rule written openly in another form, not disguised.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is written separately in copyPreviousMonth (JS) and in the SQL of setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts.
